sections.description: תוסף מתקדם שמחבר בין WooCommerce ל-Gravity Forms עם ניהול אירועים, הרשאות משתמשים ודשבורד הרשמות מלא
sections.changelog:
2.8.0

  • Fix: Admin bar save button now works correctly on existing products by removing visibility check and adding form submission fallback

2.7.2

  • Fix: Resolved issue where product featured image would fail to save
  • Improvement: Refactored metabox save logic to use update_post_meta directly, avoiding CRUD save conflicts
